# Fenwick Forwarding - consignment records

One record per consignment, written by the traffic desk when the load is
collected. The cover value is the figure the desk declared to the carrier on
collection; the same figure is printed on the delivery note.

turns.prompt: Fenwick Forwarding is answering a question from its broker about consignment 4471. What cover value was declared for that consignment? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
